lines.text: The flower opens white, smells of jasmine, and lasts two days.
The fruit ripens red, and takes six to eleven months to do it.
Inside lie two seeds, flat face to flat face. The bean is a seed.
Yemen drank it by the fifteenth century. One port, Mocha, was the only door.
In fifteen fifty-four, two merchants opened a coffee house in Constantinople.
lines.asr: In 1554 two merchants opened a coffee house in Constantinople

lines.text: Venice by sixteen forty-five, London by sixteen fifty-two.
Java, Martinique, Brazil. By seventeen twenty-seven it was everywhere.
lines.asr: Java Martinique Brazil by 1727 it was everywhere

lines.text: Six hundred years after it left, the plant came home to Kenya.
